source_revision_relation: direct ancestor of HEAD (verified 'git merge-base --is-ancestor'); the single commit between is 'docs(zapote): correct four AR-PROTCKT overstatements; add AR-COORD fuse coordination', which ADDS this dispatch and the corrected receipt. Working tree clean.

circuit_under_assessment.board: pcb/temper.kicad_pcb (retained candidate), 108/120/132 Vrms, 400 V bus, 1796.31 W requested
circuit_under_assessment.internal_discharge_loop: capacitor bank (PFC_BUS_PLUS_390V) -> shorted boost diode U10 -> a1 -> boost switch U9 -> capacitor bank (PFC_BUS_MINUS)

key_components.U9: STW65N65DM2AG boost switch (Rds_on typ 0.042 ohm, max 0.050 ohm)
key_components.U8: 760800301 boost inductor (180 uH, DCR max 20 mohm) - NOT in the internal loop
key_components.U12: HCSM2818FT10L0 10 mohm shunt - NOT in the internal loop (one terminal only)
key_components.U36-U39: LGX2W561MELC50 4 x 560 uF bus electrolytics (ESR not published)
key_components.F2 (proposed): series in the DC bus between the U10 cathode and the cap bank, on PFC_BUS_PLUS_390V

normal_current_basis.waveform: pulsed boost-diode current; F2 is in the DC bus between the boost-diode cathode and the bank
normal_current_basis.basis: RMS, because Eaton's retained FWP sheet expresses its power-loss correction against RMS load current; the 4.49 A average is NOT a sizing basis
normal_current_basis.repetitive_pulses: switching period 1/129107 Hz = 7.75 us, far below a fuse element thermal time constant, so the pulse train merges thermally and the RMS is the heating basis
missing: precharge/inrush model into the 2240 uF bank (NTC U4 + bypass relay U5 sequence, hot restart)
the FWP ambient-temperature, forced-cooling, conductor-size and altitude derating factors (none captured)

candidate_parts.applicable_revision: current revision (Eaton product specification sheet generated 2023-12-04, for technical data sheet 720025)

capacitor_discharge_rating.source: Mersen High Speed Fuses catalogue, A70QS French Cylindrical 14 mm / 22 mm

fault_impedance_assumptions.model: series R-L-C discharge from v_c(0)=400 V, i(0)=0; L di/dt + R i + v_c = 0
fault_impedance_assumptions.r_components: U10 failed-short residual + U9 failed-short residual + bank ESR (not published) + fuse resistance + layout; none measured at multi-kA
fault_impedance_assumptions.l_components: bus/loop layout + bank internal inductance; not measured
fault_impedance_assumptions.action_invariant: total action integral = stored energy / loop resistance, independent of L (verified numerically to 3.8e-14 at the probe point)
fault_impedance_assumptions.model_oracles: lossless peak approaches V0/Z0 (1.2% at R=0.1 mohm); large-R small-L peak approaches V0/R (2.4e-9); both independent limits reproduced

clearing_data.fwp_reason: no capacitor-discharge clearing characteristic or manufacturer guidance located for FWP; the 1800 A2s figure is an AC/inductive clearing I2t at rated voltage and must not be applied to a capacitor discharge
clearing_data.a70qs_class_at_400vdc: manufacturer states an 890 Vdc capacitor-discharge rating for the A70QS French Cylindrical line up to a 2.5 ms time constant; 400 Vdc < 890 Vdc so the voltage is covered, conditional on the discharge time constant
clearing_data.what_would_resolve_fwp: a manufacturer capacitor-discharge rating or let-through curve for FWP-50A14F, or an Eaton application-engineering statement, plus a sourced bank/copper withstand I2t

sourced: bank capacitance 2240.47 uF and 400 V bus (contract C1.1 + netlist)
boost-diode RMS by line (retained R0 maintained model)
FWP-50A14F current-revision ratings 700 Vdc / 50 kAIC at 700 Vdc and retained-revision 800 Vdc (two documents)
FWP-50A14F and FWP-25A14F I2t values (retained datasheet)
Mersen A70QS50-14F ratings and 890 Vdc / 2.5 ms capacitor-discharge rating (manufacturer documents)
DC voltage rating dependence on circuit time constant (Mersen DC application note)
assumed: the internal loop is a single-lumped-R series R-L-C discharge (no arc, no evolving resistance)
the R and L sweep ranges
the fuse's own resistance from rated watts loss
